mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which is positive for consumer spending and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand in the housing market, which is a positive signal for economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 decreases and CPIAUCSL increases.
